payload_contains.text: You go down into the channel and follow it east at a crouch, the roadline above your shoulder the whole way.
[Stealth] is on your field bar now: number keys, or tap it, to soften your step. Walking and doorways keep you hidden. Talking, using props, most other Skills, or starting a fight ends it.

payload_contains.speaker: Relc
payload_contains.text: Ha! Good instinct. Everybody swings wrong at the start. Might as well get it done here. Watch keeps training dummies in the gatehouse. I drag a couple out when gate duty gets slow. Don't ask about the wheels. Rules are you move and you hit. That's it. That's all the rules.

Meet (met_relc+sparred, given_spear unset): visible options ['What's out here'(0), 'You said you had something for me?'(1), 'Spar'(2), 'Keep walking'(3)] -- select index 1, the gift.
Gift node: the 'press I' teaching line.

payload_contains.speaker: Relc
payload_contains.text: My spare spear. Held gates wider than that one. Now listen. It won't help you from inside a pack. Check your pack, get the spear in your hand before you're back on the road. Sword arm, spear arm. What you carry decides which moves you get.
